concerns.concern: The combustion extension adds a new E3 condition point, but both runs remain dependent on gri30.yaml and adiabatic HP equilibrium. No matched experimental observation or compatible E3-to-E4 comparison is registered, so mechanism-independent or experimental claims are unsupported.

The solubility external test is entirely OOD across 56 records, with possible intrinsic-versus-general-aqueous semantic mismatch and limited calibration coverage. It cannot establish unrestricted failure or generalization, and the OOD refusal may be conservatively rejecting usable in-domain cases.

The docking conclusions share one receptor structure, one declared grid, and one engine, with only seed variation explored. Score separation is therefore protocol- and structure-dependent, and docking remains insufficient evidence for affinity, efficacy, or biological activity.

The battery archive lacks capacity, resistance, uncertainty, and cross-cell condition metadata. Voltage/current traces cannot be transformed into a condition-complete degradation decision without adding unsupported measurements or assumptions.

The materials line remains discovery-metadata-only: no matched record jointly specifies alloy, processing, microstructure, hydrogen environment, loading, method, property, uncertainty, and locator. Comparative embrittlement or safety conclusions are therefore not testable from the registered state.

Bundle replay demonstrates provenance and integrity, but it is not equivalent to 30 fresh engine executions; the single divergent case also makes the reproducibility boundary important to state explicitly rather than treating replay counts as independent computational replication.

limitations: This review is limited to the registered state summary and supplied record IDs; raw datasets, protocols, and artifacts were not independently re-executed.
No compatible E4 comparison is registered for combustion, and several domains remain externally blocked or entirely OOD.
The supplied acceptance state still reports final_exam_pass, master_problem_discovery_recorded, and three_live_review_roles as false, so milestone closure is not fully demonstrated.
response.summary: The methodology is strong on append-only provenance, explicit conditions, EvidenceLevel ceilings, OOD visibility, and preservation of no-decision outcomes. The principal weaknesses are unresolved external comparability, model and protocol dependence, incomplete condition metadata, and limited interpretation of replay evidence; conclusions should remain narrowly bounded until compatible independent validation is available.

concerns.concern: Combustion evidence supports only a bounded E3 computational condition extension under gri30 adiabatic-equilibrium assumptions; it does not support experimental, transient-ignition, or broader performance claims.

The DLS external result is an OOD failure for the available 56-record sample, not evidence that every solubility model fails or that unrestricted future populations are unusable; compatible in-domain validation remains absent.

Battery and materials evidence is insufficient for degradation or embrittlement decisions because required condition, property, and uncertainty metadata are missing; the preserved no-decision boundaries are appropriate and must remain visible.

Docking support remains E2 and protocol-dependent: shared 1PXX receptor structure, score aggregation, and ligand-preparation choices lack independent structural or measured-affinity validation; docking cannot justify efficacy language or a universal best-molecule claim.

Passing ledger and bundle checks establish provenance and integrity, but bundle replay is not equivalent to 30 fresh engine executions; source and engine dependence therefore must not be presented as independent validation.

response.summary: Evidence quality is auditable and most evidence ceilings and negative results are preserved. The state supports narrow computational conclusions, not broad experimental or efficacy claims; compatible external validation, matched E4 evidence, and condition-complete battery/materials records remain unresolved.

concerns.concern: Reproducibility is only partial: run IDs, bundle IDs, hashes, conditions, mechanisms, registration, and integrity checks are recorded, but the supplied state does not expose complete engine versions, configurations, or environment manifests.

The Cantera results specify mechanism and thermodynamic conditions, but solver settings, Cantera version, and environment details needed for an exact independent rerun are not demonstrated in the review state.

The molecule result has input and run digests, but the molecular representation, descriptor implementation, model or parameter versions, and execution environment are not exposed here; the input hash alone is insufficient for independent reproduction.

Docking provenance identifies the target context as murine PTGS2/COX-2 with 1PXX chain A and declared grid/seeds, but the supplied state does not establish a complete replayable run or bundle manifest, and the evidence remains dependent on one receptor structure and protocol.

The solubility external result is appropriately bounded, but exact dataset, preprocessing, frozen model, feature, and environment provenance is not demonstrated here; all 56 external records were OOD, so generalization and independent reproduction remain unresolved.

Battery and materials no-decision outcomes are reproducible as scope boundaries only. Missing capacity, resistance, uncertainty, and condition-complete materials records prevent reproduction of substantive degradation or embrittlement conclusions.
